name: SAP Fiori
summary: Applications on SAPUI5: the result of an operation is a toast that closes after 3000 ms, one message at a time, and a busy indicator starts a second after the action. The values come from the SAPUI5 documentation and source.

evidence.says: A message toast is a small overlay for a less important message that must not block the user and that fades out by itself; a message dialog blocks the page until it is closed; one message shows at a time.
The default duration of a message toast is 3000 ms, the time before its close animation starts.

evidence.source: UI5 Web Components, issue 3340, BusyIndicator: add delay property
evidence.says: The issue states that the Fiori 3 guidelines recommend starting the loading animation 1000 ms after the action.
